Can we talk about why those things look like us?|audio = Null&VoidN1Wave7-1.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 7 ([[Outpost 16]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Null Crook Boss''', internally referred to as the '''Corrupted Crook Boss''', was a summoner enemy that appeared in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had higher health than the [[Null Scout]], though it is slower than it. Upon death, it spawned a [[Null Goon]], which was a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy with lower health but faster speed. It can be spawned by the [[Null Commander]], which gives it a [[Defense]] of 50%. ==Logbook Description== "''Null Crook Boss entered the realm with his Goons in tow. For Crook Boss, it was like a rival gang stepping into his territory. He adjusted his hat; the Null Crook Boss straightened his jacket. Standing face to face, they stared each other down clutching their weapons, and in a flash, they all drew.''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Crook Boss''' is a corrupted version of the [[Crook Boss]]. It has black skin and wears a black suit with a purple shirt and tie. On its head, it wears a black fedora, black goggles and purple bandanna. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *As the '''Null Crook Boss''' spawns in a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy on death and on some waves, has that attribute itself, strong towers with hidden detection are recommended against this. **The [[Golden Scout]], [[Rocketeer]] or [[Military Base]] can be used against this. **The [[Hacker]] can be used to convert the '''Null Crook Boss''' upon death, preventing it from summoning a [[Null Goon]]. *Various methods of giving towers detections can also be used to combat this. **The [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Firework Technician]] can be used to give towers hidden detection. **[[The Sun]] can be used to give every tower all detections, however, do note it also makes the enemies immune to stun, freeze and burn. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Animation Variants}} CorruptedCrookBoss1.png|Second animation (18 October 2025 – 25 October 2025) CorruptedCrookBoss3.png|Third animation (18 October 2025 – 25 October 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNullCrook.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (18 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tower Defense Simulator - Halloween 2025 Trailer|'''Null Crook Boss''' on promotional videos. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Null Crook Boss''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon.
